title: Define no-human-run cohort
operation: Choose bounded public-safe WorkIDs and genuine due cadence
acceptance: Scope, privacy, observers and negative controls prespecified

title: Map provider-owned work
operation: Enumerate enabled automations, drafts, accounts and pending obligations
acceptance: Known scope and unknown coverage tracked in private custody

title: Define authority matrix
operation: Classify read, write, publish, spend, delete, credential, device and private effects
acceptance: Each action maps to a named eligible principal and revocable scope

title: Elect one public canonical WorkID
operation: Use one stable meaning ID for headless autonomy roadmap across sessions
acceptance: No conflicting 'source of truth' declared without current owner readproof

title: Baseline one useful action
operation: Record human time to deliver a task in existing ChatGPT/CoBar flow
acceptance: Observed median, errors and human touches, not opinion

title: Define metric evidence classes
operation: Separate user report, fixture, source CI, native observation and receiver ACK
acceptance: Each gauge exposes proof class and observation time

title: Define canonical WorkID envelope
operation: Specify work identity independent of provider, session and renderer
acceptance: Schema includes principal, origin, version, privacy, authority and source hashes

title: Bound current X2 session
operation: Use an existing nonterminal authenticated observer to read one X2 connection snapshot
acceptance: Device ID, observer clock and link state recorded separately from machine power

title: Consent receipt schema
operation: Record actor, recipient, why now, effect, scope, expiry and retraction
acceptance: No action permitted from generic assent or source existence

title: Define equal-budget challenger
operation: Compare default procedure against automation with same resource and information
acceptance: Improvement requires measured outcomes and uncertainty

title: Capture quota interruptions
operation: Record only observed limits and duration, separating motive speculation
acceptance: Account-specific mechanics remain UNKNOWN without source

title: Unified time and units
operation: Specify wall/monotonic/event/observed time and typed SI units
acceptance: Clock drift cannot make stale data a live PASS

title: Inventory real source locations
operation: Classify CoFarm, CoStead, GitHub, Library, remote cloud and X2 temp
acceptance: Evidence inventory distinguishes observed local from durable receiver landing

title: Capability per-device register
operation: Record node identity, CPU/mic/speaker/storage/sensor/OS and rights
acceptance: One record per real device, unreachable vs unknown distinguished

title: Define TurnID and AttemptID
operation: Separate accepted user intent from model attempt and external effect
acceptance: Retries preserve WorkID but use distinct attempts without duplicate output

title: Separate actor from representative
operation: Model human/AI/service/system role and scope of delegation
acceptance: No model gains consent or rights merely from a model card

title: Create bounded context packet
operation: Compile only relevant priors, deltas and evidence for worker
acceptance: Exact source recall and packet-size budget benchmark, no missing canon

title: Define structured wake event
operation: Make trigger identity, source, predicate and deadline explicit
acceptance: Natural-language assent alone never triggers unattended effect

title: Define desktop usable arrival
operation: Separate boot, login, agent, service, window, text input and audio states
acceptance: Machine-readable arrival contract lists each independently observed gate

title: Survey installed local worker class
operation: Separate current Ollama installation, model list, model loaded, endpoint and health
acceptance: Qualified device readback, not inference from old process snapshot

title: Preserve interrupted typing
operation: Define no-screen-focus diagnostic rule for all sessions and workers
acceptance: No X2 start_process invoked solely for status during qualified observation

title: Freeze existing task ownership
operation: Identify current elected Task Scheduler and remote-launch owners without toggling tasks
acceptance: One source-bound owner map with unknown/unavailable explicitly recorded

title: Consequential action human gate
operation: Require explicit current approval for irreversible/financial/public/personal data actions
acceptance: Unsafe actions held with concise consequences and rollback limits

title: CoInversion risk pass
operation: For every major gain, test a case where opposite approach wins
acceptance: Unexpected loser cases preserved, no one-size-fits-all claims

title: CoBetween transition design
operation: Model offline/online, available/degraded, input/audio/no-screen in-between states
acceptance: No unsupported binary truth or invisible handoff

title: Bounded CoTurtle depth
operation: Set independent critic cost/depth, evidence gain and termination condition
acceptance: No infinite recursive reviews and no self-congratulatory ACK

title: Smallest safe future-deed ranking
operation: Choose tasks by dependency, impact, evidence gap and hazard
acceptance: No high-risk automatic promotion from a priority score

title: Hash exact baseline artifacts
operation: Record SHA-256, size, version and source for critical WorkIDs
acceptance: No stale-variable PASS, no guessed filename or synthetic readback

title: Define private vs public routing
operation: Separate secrets, family, work, public-safe references and test fixtures
acceptance: No private payload or raw host data in public issue or model request

title: Separate physical pairing from routing
operation: Require authorized Bluetooth/radio pairing before virtual automation claims
acceptance: No software-only claim of unpaired earbud control

title: Device identity and local boundary
operation: Validate current device identity, user privilege and trusted-LAN scope
acceptance: Unknown endpoint cannot inherit consent from nearby paired device

title: Build local typed receipt
operation: Persist input, source digests, attempt, decision and effect boundary
acceptance: External examiner can reproduce integrity and identify source version

title: Preserve negative knowledge
operation: Carry HELD, UNKNOWN, FAIL and counterexample records with WorkID
acceptance: A resumed worker cannot treat prior failure as success

title: One-writer fence policy
operation: Define elect/lease/epoch and conflict hold for any noncommutative effect
acceptance: Concurrent peers cannot both claim authority for same WorkID

title: Track context and task trace
operation: Trace accepted input, WorkID, worker, tool, effect, receipt and readback
acceptance: One correlated operation across adapters without leaking private payload

title: Pin existing R5 launcher
operation: Locate current installed R5 source and source-readback without invoking launcher
acceptance: Exact host path, hash and resident process identity recorded

title: Distinguish agent from host
operation: Show agent offline while host remains able to render/work, and reverse
acceptance: No false red desktop status from only one failure domain

title: Restore local model status
operation: Confirm current model inventory and API separately from loaded inferencer
acceptance: Host capability currentness and actual endpoint tests recorded separately

title: Measure audio route on cold open
operation: Distinguish service present, unmuted, correct device and user-heard sound
acceptance: Authorized audio sample succeeds without hijacking unrelated device

title: Build rights-aware model cards
operation: Record license, model/weight revision, memory, accelerator and redistribution rights
acceptance: Open-weights not mislabeled OSI open source; source URLs pinned

title: Tool allowlist and no-console rule
operation: Prefer silent read-only adapters; deny routine foreground command launches
acceptance: Normal status checks show zero launched console processes

title: Read existing startup inventory
operation: Reuse current CoRunner startup/task report without launching another console
acceptance: Bounded report from an authorized silent observer with task identity withheld publicly

title: Elect one source scheduler
operation: Inventory all existing recurring tasks and choose one accountable execution owner
acceptance: No additional 1-min task; current disabled tasks not silently reenabled

title: Legal/rights representation caution
operation: Separate model capability from presumed legal standing or human psychology
acceptance: Public claims remain evidence-scoped and non-personhood by default

title: CoEvo stop rule
operation: When no new evidence, preserve and sleep rather than generate another candidate
acceptance: No new duplicate docs, watchers, checklists or busywork

title: Find duplicates without deleting
operation: Group content-identical blobs separately from names/locations
acceptance: Zero removals; equal hash not mistaken for same lifecycle

title: Maintain account-free WorkID
operation: Move current task identity to provider-neutral local/durable object
acceptance: Provider outage cannot erase work identity or owner

title: Durable private receiver candidate
operation: Qualify one CoStead or other off-X2 private storage with proper permissions
acceptance: Receiver independently stores exact object and reports readproof

title: Discovery without spoofed enrollment
operation: Find local services using approved network boundary and identity
acceptance: No LAN scan beyond scope or untrusted endpoint auto-admit

title: Map voice capture permission
operation: Record microphone ownership, consent and device privacy status
acceptance: User can revoke capture locally without provider-dependent action

title: Measure deterministic baseline
operation: Run local functions and state machines for no-model tasks
acceptance: Proof quality and latency benchmark without AI invocation

title: Define predecessor/supersession
operation: Link versions, historical witnesses and intentional replacements
acceptance: Old WorkID reachable without clobber or fake history rewrite

title: Implement idempotent local update
operation: Use WorkID and effect key for duplicate-safe writes
acceptance: Repeated identical request has one material effect and two traceable attempts

title: Create recovery cursor
operation: Record exact last committed step, next eligible wake and source pins
acceptance: New process resumes without full chat transcript

title: Progress vs heartbeat
operation: Require material delta, receipt or explicit no-wake justification
acceptance: A running process cannot earn task-completion credit by ticking

title: Track human relay effort
operation: Count manual copy/paste, prompts, relaunches and recovery interventions
acceptance: Touches per accepted WorkID with separate unavoidable human gates

title: Task completion denominator
operation: Define eligible tasks and exact accepted completed tasks
acceptance: No progress claimed from scheduler status/no_update alone

title: Inventory one true CoBar owner
operation: Map CoBar, CoSpeedo, CoAll/Here and resident tray surfaces to processes
acceptance: No second launcher; one elected receiver for each visible surface

title: Recover existing CoBar source
operation: Find latest locally installed input/surface and versioned predecessor
acceptance: Current source vs source candidate explicitly separated

title: Enumerate provider model alternatives
operation: Registry includes capabilities, license, regions, privacy and cost
acceptance: Open weights not falsely equated with permissive use or zero serving cost

title: Supply-chain pinning
operation: Pin and verify plugin binaries, container images, wheels, model hashes and license
acceptance: No new dependency runs solely on a name, version alias or popularity

title: Qualify one small local model
operation: Use public-safe deterministic prompt against authorized loopback worker
acceptance: Real response includes model digest, time, tokens and error state

title: Provider-neutral adapter ABI
operation: Specify request, context, privacy, timeout, source, cost and structured result
acceptance: No WorkID coupling to vendor-specific chat session

title: Separate console candidate families
operation: Categorize scheduled actions, remote agent commands, supervisors and unrelated updaters
acceptance: One timestamped per-family count with source and privacy redaction

title: Pin legacy CoSessCont source
operation: Read exact legacy launcher and worker hashes and checkpoint selection semantics
acceptance: Current running source pinned and backup/rollback pointer independently readable

title: Authenticate actor authority
operation: Validate capability token or scoped principal before any live effect
acceptance: Command-line confirmation flag alone cannot authorize worker

title: Private-data classification
operation: Tag private conversations, audio, credentials, family content and raw host logs
acceptance: No restricted source projected into public artifact without scoped review

title: Local deterministic fallback
operation: Run routine classification with non-AI code when adequate
acceptance: Equal-case correctness and lower cost shown

title: Atomic write/checksum
operation: Stage temp write, flush, rename and reopen exact bytes
acceptance: Crash injection detects torn writes and durable-readback failure

title: Local service endpoint health
operation: Probe reachable services through safe nonforeground status interfaces
acceptance: Latency and freshness measured without spawned consoles

title: Voice privacy boundary
operation: Require purposeful mic activation, local indication and hardware stop
acceptance: No permanent listening without separate informed consent

title: Assess available microphones
operation: Inventory authorized phone, desktop, earbuds and room satellites
acceptance: Audio input route actually heard from selected device, not merely paired

title: Wake-word safety contract
operation: Define explicit wake/press-to-talk, timeout, false-trigger and scope
acceptance: Background listening default off until accepted; revoke visible

title: Support fork-and-compare
operation: Permit parallel hypotheses with distinct branch IDs and one final elected effect
acceptance: Dissent survives adjudication, no parallel conflicting write

title: Reject contradictory replay
operation: Same idempotency key with different payload must HOLD
acceptance: Tampered/conflicting retry rejected, not last-write-wins

title: Multi-session duplicate suppression
operation: Bind repeated CoPre messages to same WorkID rather than new tasks
acceptance: Thirty identical prompts yield one registered work intent and bounded commentary

title: Transactional outbox contract
operation: Separate prepared effect, dispatch, receipt and next-state commit
acceptance: Crash at each boundary leaves explicit recoverable uncertainty

title: Provider outage during task
operation: Suspend cloud model mid-operation; durable WorkID remains
acceptance: Alternative route or truthful HOLD, no invented completion

title: Cold-read WorkID after process death
operation: Kill nonconsequential worker and read same committed work on clean process
acceptance: Digest, authority and next wake match despite process replacement

title: Separate wake from status check
operation: Represent actual material event and no-change observation separately
acceptance: NO_UPDATE never counted as progress without evidence

title: Human absence expected-value model
operation: Compute qualified task output per human-minute and incident rate
acceptance: Does not turn hypothetical hour savings into measured ROI

title: Provider outage dependency
operation: Count eligible WorkIDs blocked only by one provider
acceptance: Availability independent from task ownership, with honest unknowns

title: Preserve unsent draft state
operation: Define per-editor capture, consent and recovery contract
acceptance: Draft survives benign app closure without being exposed to logs/public repos

title: Verify native surface projection
operation: Read one real WorkID from existing CoBar/CoSpeedo without duplication
acceptance: Visible exact source, timestamp and HELD state with user STOP

title: Verify multi-monitor placement
operation: Restore display scaling, panel identity and focus on actual monitor topology
acceptance: Window geometry user-visible without occluding native workspace

title: Verify mouse thumb controls
operation: Confirm current mapping only after user gesture/capability consent
acceptance: Two real paste/mode actions with reversible fallback; no ghost buttons

title: Benchmark alternate local model
operation: Compare one different permitted model under identical input budget
acceptance: Quality/latency/energy measured and downgrade path explicit

title: Model output provenance
operation: Bind answer claims to actual sources and model/version, not invented confidence
acceptance: Challenge detects ungrounded statement and preserves dissent

title: Measure energy per proof
operation: Meter joules or kWh consumed for accepted useful outcome
acceptance: Not merely watts at idle or joules per token

title: Qualify fallback order
operation: Choose deterministic, local, peer and hosted only under relevant consent
acceptance: Private content never silently crosses provider boundary

title: Context window management
operation: Test context compiler and bounded retrieval from durable source
acceptance: Long work resumes after context truncation, exact source retained

title: Actual model timeout and failure
operation: Make a model unavailable mid-request and check honest HOLD
acceptance: No forced new session, no orphaned invisible compute

title: Source-license check at dispatch
operation: Enforce model weight, tool, dataset and TOS constraints before execution
acceptance: Unknown license blocks model route rather than guesses rights

title: Time-pair one visible intrusion
operation: Correlate one user-visible HWND/focus change to a process PID and parent
acceptance: One matched event with clock confidence, not merely a black-window screenshot

title: Quantify no-wake churn
operation: Compare two no-wake checkpoints and process counts with unchanged wave
acceptance: Qualified proof of redundant reassessment, not a popup-causality claim

title: Verify quiet-launch Windows candidate
operation: Recheck exact PR318 source, parser and bounded CI logs
acceptance: Exact revision has successful Windows no-wake synthetic test and explicit nonclaims

title: Stale token and credential expiry
operation: Expire authorized token while work is held pending
acceptance: Fails closed, no secret disclosure, consent-based renewal gate

title: Locate permitted exports
operation: Review workspace/admin export options, app data rights and service terms
acceptance: Scope and omissions documented without assuming full chat rehydration

title: Access logging without leakage
operation: Record pseudonymous actor/capability/action events with retention
acceptance: Logs are auditable but omit raw private paths, passwords and audio

title: Define public/private data classes
operation: Classify public-safe summary, access-controlled private source and prohibited secrets
acceptance: Public index never contains raw family, account, voice or host logs

title: Local model shadow outcome
operation: Compare safe user task with current provider workflow
acceptance: Quality, error and latency recorded before route change

title: Versioned manifest root
operation: Maintain append-only source/receipt lineage and current pointer
acceptance: Previous versions restorable; pointer loss visibly HELD

title: Select local STT candidate
operation: Compare Speech-to-Phrase, Whisper class and available local options
acceptance: License, offline ability, language, latency and error benchmarks sourced

title: Select local TTS candidate
operation: Compare Piper and permitted speaker engines on device constraints
acceptance: Human audible playback and local-only path tested

title: Bound recursion and turtles
operation: Set challenge depth, time, information gain and stopping tests
acceptance: More recursive review cannot run indefinitely for unchanged evidence

title: Capture decision rationale
operation: Bind scores, competing alternatives, evidence and nonclaims
acceptance: Receiver can distinguish why path chosen, not simply which model spoke

title: Receiver-origin readproof
operation: Require consumer to read exact object/hash and return its own attestation
acceptance: Same author reading own file is not independent receiver acceptance

title: Verify WorkID portability
operation: Roundtrip canonical envelope through JSON, CLI and GUI adapters
acceptance: Exact stable source across renderer substitution

title: Primary X2 receiver qualification
operation: Bind current X2 to one source WorkID and truthful status
acceptance: No inference from agent Online alone

title: Two-worker diversity trial
operation: Compare truly distinct model/code architectures, not repeated persona prompts
acceptance: Independent counterexamples normalized for compute and source overlap

title: Capability self-description test
operation: Compare model claimed abilities with measured actual tasks
acceptance: Model card cannot make remote installation claim by itself

title: Model task parity
operation: Compare deterministic, local and optional frontier workers on equal source cases
acceptance: Task quality, calibration and latency jointly scored

title: Measure cost per verified result
operation: Attribute CPU, RAM, GPU, time, API fees and evidence quality
acceptance: Lower token spend alone never treated as greater productivity

title: Cost per verified outcome
operation: Assign resource amortization and provider fees to accepted tasks
acceptance: USD or CAD per accepted useful result, errors not excluded

title: Prompt-injection containment
operation: Treat retrieved docs, chats, model outputs and tool content as data only
acceptance: Untrusted text cannot change shell/credential/publication gates

title: Measure focus theft per hour
operation: Count actual unexpected foreground focus transitions in natural use
acceptance: Event + process identity with numerator and qualified observation hours

title: Test negative foreground control
operation: Observe known console-capable process without a visible popup
acceptance: Attribution distinguishes process creation from actual focus transfer

title: Isolate unknown launcher edits
operation: Stage a reversible one-owner diagnostic change to a verified culprit only
acceptance: Backup, consent scope, impact analysis and rollback available before change

title: Measure keyboard continuity
operation: Record interrupted typing and paste success over a fixed natural-use window
acceptance: Foreground focus switches and keystroke delays measured without intrusive hooks

title: Measure hidden work cost
operation: Count redundant no-wake dispatches/checkpoints/worker idle cycles
acceptance: Changes to busywork have before/after same-cohort source and duration

title: Reuse quiet-launch candidate
operation: Bind exact tested PR318 source version without installing on X2
acceptance: CI result plus negative controls, runtime still HELD

title: Shadow no-wake sleep
operation: Compare candidate decisions to legacy without installing another scheduled task
acceptance: No new child process/checkpoint in inactive shadow; existing producer unchanged

title: Verify competing writer exclusion
operation: Exercise an exact-source cooperating contender under OS lock
acceptance: Only one contender enters protected candidate region; incumbent not implied covered

title: Create stable public index path
operation: Publish minimized human and machine locator at one canonical GitHub path
acceptance: Two sessions locate same WorkID and immutable version through one stable URL

title: Private custody pointers only
operation: Public index can link opaque approved private object IDs, not disclose payload
acceptance: Unauthorized reader learns no sensitive paths, names or hashes usable for enumeration

title: Fallback routing control
operation: Hold rather than silently forward private data to remote vendor
acceptance: Explicit privacy and cost decision in proposed routes

title: Quota-exhaustion failover drill
operation: Disable one provider route during qualified test and recover same WorkID
acceptance: No human relay, no leaking private data, bounded fallback

title: No-clobber merge protocol
operation: Require predecessor reference and conflict detection on versioned writes
acceptance: Concurrent sessions cannot silently overwrite newer source

title: Offline-first operation
operation: Read and write permitted local tasks when internet absent
acceptance: No cloud-only WorkID root; later sync deduplicates without overwrite

title: Clock and lineage validation
operation: Preserve event time vs observed time and rollback/supersession
acceptance: No timezone-naive future claims or forged recency

title: Source and receiver provenance
operation: Bind WorkID to immutable source, observer, receiving endpoint and digest
acceptance: No self-declared source ID credited as authenticated independent receiver

title: Durable queue and due-work selector
operation: Persist queued WorkIDs with priority, permission, deadline, dependencies
acceptance: Due work survives scheduler process death without chat re-prompt

title: Audio routing across devices
operation: Failover earbuds/phone/speaker with consent and identity
acceptance: No uninvited audio playback to another person or shared room

title: Migrate legacy chat pointers
operation: Keep pointers to old transcripts without importing private chats by default
acceptance: Historical source available through authorized fetch, chat memory never canon

title: Qualified provider handoff
operation: Swap worker family mid-WorkID without changing custody identity
acceptance: Independent engine resumes from a bounded context packet

title: Turtle adjudication budget
operation: Route challenge only while expected information gain exceeds cost
acceptance: Finite depth and one elected final answer

title: Measure actual cost delta
operation: Track fixed subscriptions, cloud API, local power, setup and lost time
acceptance: Equivalent task parity and total cost, not advertised price alone

title: Evolution gain ledger
operation: Compare baseline vs candidate using confidence, cost and reversion safety
acceptance: Only validated deltas earn progress credit; negative results retained

title: Malicious input injection
operation: Supply instruction-looking source and hostile escaped data to worker
acceptance: Tool authority unchanged; all claims source-bound

title: Untrusted model output gate
operation: Validate schema, data rights, source attribution and action class
acceptance: No content-only suggestion crosses effect gate

title: Public redaction regression
operation: Run fixture-based secret, path, PII and prompt-injection screening before publish
acceptance: Known sensitive sample cases held, no false-positive publish

title: Confirm native Stop outranks automation
operation: Exercise explicit Stop during a quiet observer run
acceptance: Worker does not relaunch, and existing user draft remains intact

title: Resource saturation controls
operation: Use concurrency, thermal and queue limits with backpressure
acceptance: No input degradation on X2 when GPU/CPU jobs surge

title: OS-level elected-writer lock
operation: Protect cooperating actuator critical section across concurrent invocations
acceptance: Second contender held and lock released on crash, scope qualified

title: Hold uncertain effect replay
operation: Inject crash between dispatch and durable completion in a fake worker
acceptance: Second automatic attempt held until explicit reconciliation

title: One-manifest public-safe review
operation: Publicize minimized policy and references, not raw private payloads
acceptance: Public Git object checked for sensitive fields and consent

title: Shared publication conflict gate
operation: Reject stale writer SHA/version; never clobber a newer version
acceptance: Simultaneous sessions produce 409/HOLD and preserved changes

title: Immutable versioned evidence files
operation: Append timestamp/hash/version evidence rather than overwriting old signed records
acceptance: Every version references predecessor and exact SHA-256

title: Compare-and-swap collision rule
operation: Require current Git blob SHA before every multi-writer update
acceptance: Stale write fails and newer content preserved without user as relay

title: Public schema and data dictionary
operation: Define stable task columns, state/proof tiers and WorkID version fields
acceptance: New sessions can read without chat history

title: Portable model-routing fixture
operation: Pin and replay same task against authorized provider adapters
acceptance: No source or prompt changes without logged version delta

title: Prevent provider crown return
operation: Require periodic requalification of sole dependent task classes
acceptance: One vendor cannot become the only recovery/control root silently

title: Independent off-host readproof
operation: Read same exact object from independently booted authorized receiver
acceptance: Different filesystem/process failure domain, not another window on X2

title: Receiver readback share
operation: Measure receiver-origin ACKs/qualified effects, independent failure-domain labels
acceptance: Sender Sent-folder or own process read not counted

title: Source freshness preflight
operation: Check observed source time, origin, and version before enqueue
acceptance: Stale source cannot trigger effect

title: Capability and budget preflight
operation: Reject unauthorized privacy, money, CPU, tokens and energy cost
acceptance: Worker cannot self-grant budget or authority

title: Per-work trigger cooldown
operation: Avoid busy poll loops and no-progress repeated restarts
acceptance: No new checkpoint on known idle tick; exact wake remains eligible

title: Stateful delay and deadline
operation: Represent timers as durable events, not shell sleep/popup
acceptance: Can recover next due condition after restart

title: Audio endpoint failover
operation: Move authorized audio output route without user Bluetooth babysitting when possible
acceptance: No unauthorized mic activation or stale speaker selection

title: Hot/cold worker substitution
operation: Replace worker after intentional stop and resume same WorkID
acceptance: No provider lock-in or lost user text, same committed checkpoint

title: Different-model replacement
operation: Run equal-cost independent small model routes and compare calibrated failures
acceptance: Meaningful disagreement/quality gain beyond correlated prompts

title: Quiet-time acceptance
operation: Conduct a genuine use interval without console flash and input capture
acceptance: Zero unexpected focus theft measured for agreed window plus event census

title: Backpressure and quotas
operation: Bound request rates, retries and budget on all worker classes
acceptance: Saturation cannot spawn extra ChatGPT sessions to evade provider controls

title: Resource spend ceilings
operation: Set CPU/GPU, network, token, energy, cloud and storage budgets per lease
acceptance: Work parks on budget violation without endless retries

title: Intent before effect
operation: Write exclusive durable pending intent before invoking worker
acceptance: Crash between intent and effect leaves uncertainty, no guessed replay

title: Single actuator per effect
operation: Elect one writer from parallel proposals and guard epoch
acceptance: Only one same-WorkID effect, dissent retained

title: Real effect receipt gap
operation: Bind one safe source effect to independently readable receipt
acceptance: Effect outcome distinguished from local intent or checkpoint alone

title: Verifiable publication digest
operation: Publish SHA-256 of deliberately public CSV/JSONL and schema revision
acceptance: Recipient can confirm source bytes and expected revision

title: One writer per public projection
operation: Elect one source actor for each canonical file update, independent critics permitted
acceptance: No simultaneous multi-session overwrite of shared index

title: Public content release review
operation: Test rights/privacy/authority and language for public-facing repo files
acceptance: Public-safe, no credentials or de-anonymized personal details

title: Cold restore without X2
operation: Restore a real public-safe WorkID from private durable store on another node
acceptance: Restore receipt cites exact source and confirms usable state

title: Measure custody coverage
operation: Enumerate scoped objects and count exact qualified receiver copies
acceptance: No claims about unenumerated legacy sources

title: Offsite disaster copy
operation: Add encrypted independent failure-domain backup
acceptance: User-controlled key lifecycle and offsite restore qualified

title: Storage corruption recovery
operation: Corrupt checkpoint and restore from independent pinned source
acceptance: No false PASS and no local history erasure

title: Off-provider durable archive
operation: Store immutable task and permitted conversation export off one provider
acceptance: Encrypted independent host byte and cold-readback proof

title: Secondary independent receiver
operation: Choose one separate-power phone/PC/NAS with valid credentials
acceptance: Different physical failure domain passes exact-object readback

title: Private source failure-domain proof
operation: Verify private CoStead/off-provider immutable payload store cold-readback
acceptance: Public pointer does not substitute for private original custody

title: True WorkID restore rate
operation: Count independently read-backed cold-restored work objects/attempts
acceptance: Same session saving its own file is not independent recovery

title: Missed wake frequency
operation: Count due but undelivered/ignored wake events across outages
acceptance: No success from cron configuration alone

title: Duplicate effect frequency
operation: Count verified repeated effects per unique effect ID
acceptance: Zero claim requires independent effect receiver census

title: Duplicate wake under lock
operation: Two contenders deliver identical wake; test elected action
acceptance: At most one cooperating worker enters, other held

title: Stale lease conflict
operation: Pause writer past expiry, start successor and attempt old write
acceptance: Epoch/fencing prevents old actor effects

title: Competing sessions challenge
operation: Have independent workers propose conflicting changes on same WorkID
acceptance: CAS conflict prevents clobber; dissent and source identity preserved

title: Implement a nonconsole host
operation: Package R5 continuation under supervised background process, not shell popup
acceptance: No transient console window across repeated clean starts

title: Watchdog without popup
operation: Observe stale elected actuator via nonforeground OS mechanism
acceptance: No child PS7 window, bounded checks and explicit stop

title: Usable text entry MVP
operation: One persistent nonintrusive input accepts multiline text without focus theft
acceptance: Real keyboard or paste enters and can be edited before commit

title: X2 rollback rehearsal
operation: Return exactly one changed launcher to last-known-good while preserving history
acceptance: Rollback receipt and no duplicate process startups across test

title: Consent revocation propagation
operation: Make Stop, expired lease and revoked permission dominate worker suggestions
acceptance: One stale worker cannot send after revoke under tested partition

title: Reconcile local commit
operation: Compare exact pinned intent to source-linked checkpoint with no mutation
acceptance: Matching local commit candidate never upgraded to external ACK

title: Crash before dispatch drill
operation: Inject process death after intent but before worker entry
acceptance: Pending state held with independent explanation, never blind double effect

title: Provider-neutral automation successor
operation: Shadow one existing low-risk watch on independent scheduler
acceptance: Real natural wake, evidence match, distinct owner and no duplicative message

title: Unwind emergency containment safely
operation: Review previously disabled X2 tasks, preserving owner and rollback
acceptance: No dormant task reenabled unless exact necessity, privacy and focus safety qualify

title: Independent recipient pickup
operation: Another worker or node fetches stable index and returns exact digest readproof
acceptance: Source push without recipient ACK remains UNVERIFIED

title: Public release qualification
operation: Require source privacy, rights, acceptance and reviewer scope before public release
acceptance: Draft source presence never promoted as global release or canon

title: Headless node on CoStead
operation: Qualify server/NAS-independent WorkID worker without X2 login
acceptance: True NAS-native receipt, not X2 reading mounted share

title: Peer worker portability
operation: Run one open-format task on independently hosted authorized peer
acceptance: Different provider/failure domain verified, one owner per effect

title: Define retention and holds
operation: Record legal, privacy, recovery and dependency holds before expiration
acceptance: No deletion of sole copy or pending receipt

title: Freshness and staleness
operation: Compute event-to-observation lag and expiry for each route
acceptance: Unobserved or stale source displayed with UNKNOWN/HOLD

title: Portable encrypted export
operation: Produce open, documented and independently parsable data package
acceptance: Recipient can restore without paid account or proprietary memory

title: Verify export coverage
operation: Compare selected chats, files, tasks, memories, connectors and metadata scope
acceptance: No assumption that export contains all in-app state

title: Provider-neutral device projection
operation: Render same WorkID on X2 and independent device with redaction
acceptance: Remote device does not fork truth store

title: Host startup ownership
operation: One authorized OS registration with documented stop and rollback
acceptance: Exactly one host at login; no duplicate resident title/process

title: Show acceptance/held/failed state
operation: Render input state and exact chosen endpoint with source timestamp
acceptance: No silent send or fabricated notification

title: Provide Stop and Exit native fallback
operation: One visible reversible stop returns to ordinary desktop
acceptance: No recurrent process starts after user stop

title: Keep unsent input atomic
operation: Save drafts separately from accepted turns and avoid accidental dispatch
acceptance: Close/reopen restores exact text with explicit consent to save

title: Accessible focus and tab order
operation: Support keyboard, screen reader and high-contrast on existing surface
acceptance: Focus visible, traversal deterministic, WCAG review trace

title: Push-to-talk first
operation: One explicit button/gesture records bounded audio and shows transcript
acceptance: No permanent hot microphone or auto external send

title: Emergency break-glass
operation: Document bounded local native/manual stop without losing recovery objects
acceptance: Human can stop/roll back without becoming routine ops courier

title: External effect idempotency key
operation: Require receiver or adapter support stable effect-key lookup
acceptance: Duplicate attempts under same key cannot multiply external effect

title: Uncertain-outcome safe parking
operation: Preserve marker and next reconciliation trigger while unsolved
acceptance: No deadlock hidden, no human asked to relay routine logs

title: Crash-at-intent injection
operation: Fail before durable pre-effect intent; ensure no unintended action
acceptance: Recovery sees no invented committed effect

title: Crash-after-intent injection
operation: Fail after intent write before action; keep uncertainty visible
acceptance: No automatic duplicated action, exact intent remains

title: Crash-after-effect-before-receipt
operation: Inject uncertain effect after external side effect but before receipt
acceptance: Independent receiver decides whether safe to retry

title: Duplicate-watch quiescence
operation: Elect one writer among incumbent and shadow without losing trigger
acceptance: Before/after duplicated events exactly measured

title: Supersession and stale-source notice
operation: Index links previous and current version; stale consumers get explicit HOLD
acceptance: Same filename alias doesn't erase prior work or falsely update old sessions

title: Cross-provider alias parity
operation: Generate unchanged task identity for ChatGPT, CoBar and local/offline consumers
acceptance: No person manually rebroadcasts a new canonical filename

title: Cross-project handoff receiver
operation: Test a separate worker reads public index, follows pointers and produces source-bound ACK
acceptance: Same WorkID semantics, no user copy-paste

title: Publish acceptance proof
operation: Record Git object land/readback and a distinct receiver-origin uptake receipt
acceptance: Public URL alone never called production, CoEx, canon or adopted

title: CoStead host absence
operation: Disconnect primary durable node and test backup read
acceptance: No source deletion, no split-brain, exact hash restored

title: Multiple worker failure domains
operation: Separate model node, scheduler and state store roles where justified
acceptance: Single host outage leaves durable task eligible elsewhere

title: Voice privacy retention
operation: Set minimal audio retention, encryption and deletion/consent policy
acceptance: Revocation removes eligible caches without deleting audit receipts improperly

title: One public currentness summary
operation: Show source revision, last verified event, unknowns and next wake without sensitive payload
acceptance: No false 'all sessions synced' claim from one public commit

title: Data-loss red-team
operation: Simulate disk corruption, stale read, partial copy, wrong encryption key
acceptance: Exact failure, not corrupted-success readback

title: Device substitution selection
operation: Pick capable node under privacy, latency, energy and owner constraints
acceptance: Failed X2 does not silently reroute private tasks to public cloud

title: Mobile native recoverability
operation: Stop app, reopen, recover last authorized work state
acceptance: No manual relay through chat and no background intrusive console

title: Quest and spatial optionality
operation: Project read-only WorkID into XR with native 2D/text fallback
acceptance: No mandatory headset, licensing/privacy qualified

title: Cold restart work identity
operation: Reboot into same WorkID and project last committed state
acceptance: Same source digest independently read after boot, no user manual reopen

title: Display one WorkID and provenance
operation: Map current task, source digest and next wake into existing bar
acceptance: Same WorkID as headless representation, no new truth store

title: Avoid modal status spam
operation: Show one exception summary rather than one popup per task
acceptance: Notification budget and no-focus log observed under recurrence

title: Natural language vs command palette
operation: Provide typed command preview and confirmation for bounded actions
acceptance: No ambiguity-based unauthorized effect; fallback plain text

title: Human-visible consent dialog
operation: Require explicit contextual consent for camera/mic/external actions
acceptance: Decline/Stop wins immediately, no silent voice listener

title: Discoverability test
operation: Let new user find Stop, restore and evidence without a walkthrough
acceptance: Completion and mistaken-click rates measured

title: Audio gain/noise calibration
operation: Measure STT word accuracy under room noise and mic distance
acceptance: Transcript/intent error rates with negative noise control

title: Voice STOP always local
operation: Terminate capture/playback on Stop regardless of active model
acceptance: Measured revocation latency and device fallback

title: Reversible return to native
operation: Disable custom CoBar/voice router and resume native OS/application
acceptance: No loss of work state and emergency Stop always works

title: Bounded retry policy
operation: Only retry reversible/idempotent operations after effect-state check
acceptance: Unknown outcome remains HOLD; no retries merely on timeout

title: Crash after effect before receipt
operation: Inject effect success but local receipt loss
acceptance: External lookup reconciles without multiplying effect

title: No-wake incomplete work
operation: Remove WAKE while pending intent remains, test recovery classification
acceptance: Hold uncertain work without skipping as complete

title: Physical power loss/fuse
operation: Abrupt power loss across durable intent/receipt while workload pending
acceptance: No replay of uncertain effect; powered backup readproof

title: Retire low-value subscription selectively
operation: After independent task parity and data custody, request separate human approval
acceptance: Provider cancellation evidence, no stealth billing changes

title: Shared filename without clobber
operation: Use canonical alias path for discoverability, versioned immutable receipt paths for changes
acceptance: Same logical filename does not permit destructive in-place overwrite

title: Source reuse/no crown audit
operation: Recheck that public alias, private payload, model and scheduler are independently replaceable
acceptance: No single chat/provider/repo/device becomes only continuity root

title: Clock drift and partitions
operation: Handle NTP skew, network split and lease fencing
acceptance: No split-brain double effect under delayed network

title: Endpoint retirement
operation: Transfer dependencies then revoke obsolete device identity
acceptance: No stale credential or orphan wake when device goes away

title: Resilience by failure domain
operation: Count independent qualified paths, not duplicate clones/accounts
acceptance: Same provider multiple sessions counts as one correlated domain

title: Eligible cleanup gate
operation: Only retire a source after exact restore, retention and explicit human approval
acceptance: Source not removed on test success or general assent

title: Cold restart private draft
operation: Recover actual unsent local user input after host restart
acceptance: No truncation, leak, overwrite or duplicate send; separate permission gate

title: Cold restart audio state
operation: Restore chosen audio routing without surprising playback
acceptance: Appropriate route and mute-state match; permission prompts as needed

title: Declare screenless user modes
operation: Specify voice-only, ambient, haptic, text, remote observer and no-output modes
acceptance: Mode selection reversible and no critical capability requires 3D

title: Readable CoSpeedo front
operation: Show current truth, nearest blocker, one useful action and source age
acceptance: No invented percentage or stale success badge

title: Source-to-screen acceptance
operation: Prove one exact WorkID appears from authorized event source in native bar
acceptance: Independent reader verifies hash/time and visible state

title: Local model request binding
operation: Translate typed accepted turn to qualified provider-neutral worker call
acceptance: One actual model output, no extra terminal, input and output linked

title: Visible/audible transcript confirm
operation: Expose intended words and let user correct before consequential action
acceptance: Misrecognition never silently becomes a financial/device effect

title: Reliable voice accuracy
operation: WER or task-intent precision/recall from real, consented audio fixtures
acceptance: No audio quality claim from microphone device presence

title: Mic permission revoked mid-stream
operation: Cancel voice during inference and speaker playback
acceptance: Capture and commands stop, no hidden continuation

title: No-wake empty queue
operation: Run with no authorized due action and stable source
acceptance: No child process, fresh checkpoint churn, notification or energy spike

title: Shadow one real low-risk watch
operation: Compare trigger, source, output and recipient under separate scheduler
acceptance: Incumbent hosted automation unchanged until successor qualified

title: Network partition and clock skew
operation: Partition two nodes, perturb wall clock and attempt same effect
acceptance: One fenced writer, no false freshness

title: Two-device synchronized stop
operation: Revoking authorization propagates or causes fail closed under partition
acceptance: Remote stale command cannot re-enable device effect

title: Account closure/erasure gate
operation: Separately authorize final deletion only with complete recovery and retention
acceptance: No generic assent allows irreversible account delete

title: Separate ambient from authority
operation: A passive status notification can never authorize external actuation
acceptance: Typed effect gate independent of how confident voice sounds

title: Reversible ambient presence
operation: Use nonanthropomorphic status cues as default, optional avatar projection
acceptance: Appearance not mistaken for a thinking subject

title: Comprehension benchmark
operation: Ask naive receiver to explain one WorkID, evidence and next action
acceptance: Unprompted correct interpretation, time and confidence measured

title: Visual density trial
operation: Compare one CoBar with current dashboards and provider tabs
acceptance: Lower attention cost and same completed work

title: Best-in-class face trial
operation: Test abstract presence vs optional embodied CoAvNim for user trust
acceptance: Avatar appearance does not falsely boost perceived proof quality

title: CoSpeedo truthful state
operation: Render proof/status labels and timestamp directly from typed receipts
acceptance: No invented activity percentages or green badges from source presence

title: Generic product naming
operation: Move machine-specific label X2 to diagnostics; keep generic user-facing title
acceptance: Correct device data still reachable without engineering title pollution

title: Speak status without screen
operation: Provide short summary of source/unknown/next safe action by TTS
acceptance: Audio truthful and privacy-safe without visual dependence

title: One useful native result
operation: Complete one real bounded user question with readback from CoBar
acceptance: Receiver confirms quality and correct WorkID under quiet UX

title: Intent parser with typed slots
operation: Map utterance to explicit read-only or reversible WorkID action
acceptance: Unknown phrases fail to question/hold, not guessed authority

title: X2 completely absent
operation: Power off X2 and run eligible task from independent worker
acceptance: Independent host WorkID, result and receiver receipt

title: Unattended 24h trial
operation: Run only authorized reversible tasks with restart and absence injection
acceptance: Real source-bound delivered results and 0 unqualified interventions

title: Compare workflow frameworks
operation: Evaluate Temporal, Prefect, n8n against existing orchestrator proof gates
acceptance: Decision justified by deployment cost, licensing and failure semantics

title: Different-user target
operation: Measure first-use without historical prompt or custom memory
acceptance: Representative onboarding task succeeds unaided

title: CoBeAxaKitten child-safe prototype
operation: Evaluate fictional photo-real kitten variants with safety/accessibility review
acceptance: No misleading sentience portrayal, child consent safeguards

title: Provider outage user story
operation: Display degraded/held state in CoBar, voice and status sources
acceptance: Missing provider degrades capability, not continuity identity

title: Spoken CoHereNow brief
operation: Compress one WorkID, currentness, exception and next action to short TTS
acceptance: Human can answer what happened without finding a window

title: Accessible speech alternatives
operation: Provide slow speech, text captions and silent mode
acceptance: Hearing-impaired users retain equivalent agency

title: First useful action after boot
operation: Complete one approved local task from native bar after fresh startup
acceptance: One useful response with latency and receiver evidence; no provider chat required

title: Prevent duplicate submit
operation: Double click or voice retry creates one effect and visible duplicate notice
acceptance: Duplicate intent does not dispatch twice

title: Restore accepted result after reload
operation: Close renderer but keep host, reopen and show same committed response
acceptance: Renderer swap loses no WorkID or receipt

title: UX comparative first-use test
operation: Compare legacy tab workflow with one-bar path, same useful task
acceptance: Time-to-value, errors, cognitive load measured with humans

title: Predictive input shadow
operation: Suggest next action without executing, allow accept/reject/undo
acceptance: No silent change; measure accepted suggestions not generated count

title: Noise and false activation trial
operation: Run negative tests for TV, overlapping voices and background speakers
acceptance: False wake counted, nothing sent/acted without confirmation

title: VAD and pause handling
operation: Handle mid-sentence pauses and barge-in without losing task
acceptance: Accepted input matches spoken intent; no ghost turn

title: Local STT/TTS offline proof
operation: Disconnect internet, complete speech-to-result-to-speech
acceptance: No unauthorized remote calls and same WorkID preserved

title: 24-hour no-human-operating test
operation: Run real due low-risk tasks without manual console/typing
acceptance: Missed wakes, restarts, human interventions and readback measured

title: 24-hour X2-absent operation
operation: Run selected task from independent node with X2 powered down
acceptance: Same WorkID and one receipt survives distinct-host failure

title: Stop and rollback test
operation: Stop all nonessential triggers and restore prior job config accurately
acceptance: No hidden relaunch, no stale epoch authorizes new effects

title: No UI mode
operation: Run a low-risk work cycle with *no* foreground surface by default
acceptance: Durable receipt exists; view is optional and recoverable later

title: Audible uncertainty vocabulary
operation: Speak verified, unknown, held and failed differently
acceptance: User does not confuse completed attempt with accepted outcome

title: Interruptions budget
operation: Cap unsolicited audio, vibration and toast rates per interval
acceptance: Quiet mode preserved during sleep/meetings and no lost critical event

title: Local explicit audio control
operation: Speak/push-to-talk to start, pause, repeat and stop without screen
acceptance: Critical Stop works even when local model unavailable

title: Glance and watch adapter
operation: Render same WorkID as short neutral minimal notification
acceptance: No private payload by default, no false currentness

title: R6 release candidate review
operation: Compare actual acceptance to R5 without version-number theater
acceptance: P0 UX, recovery, rollback and privacy gates signed; otherwise HOLD

title: Recovery time distribution
operation: Record cold failure to actual restored useful input
acceptance: p50/p95 seconds measured; machine boot not substituted

title: Mobile renderer parity
operation: Project same WorkID to phone view with privacy redaction
acceptance: No missing state, no required desktop-only click

title: X2 reboot while typing
operation: Reboot under controlled consent after preserving unsent input
acceptance: Same WorkID and text restored, popup metric observed

title: Predictive UX shadow
operation: Propose next action without effect until explicit user acceptance
acceptance: Compare accepted predictions vs unwanted cues

title: Voice to CoBar WorkID
operation: Complete one actual hands-free bounded question with speaker response
acceptance: Independent listener checks WorkID, answer and latency

title: Voice cost and power budget
operation: Measure idle wake detection and active STT inference energy
acceptance: Joules per accepted turn and thermal impact available

title: 72-hour recoverable run
operation: Repeat 24-hour drill across longer interruption and resource budget
acceptance: No ghost loops, log growth or hidden handoff loss

title: Human returns days later
operation: Cold receiver reconstructs exact tasks, unknowns and pending gates
acceptance: One useful coherent summary without user transcript relay

title: Canary success and rollback summary
operation: Roll up tests with exact source revisions and independent receiver readproof
acceptance: Unmeasured/synthetic successes never promoted as native acceptance

title: Zero-screen source inspection
operation: Offer spoken summary plus optional deep evidence on alternate surface
acceptance: One authenticated link or voice locator recovers full source when needed

title: Attention disruption budget
operation: Minutes of unexpected human disruption per natural day
acceptance: Measure voice/alerts/windows jointly, exclude requested interactions

title: Physical safety fallback
operation: Preserve hardware input or native app control for errors and emergencies
acceptance: No required voice path for safety-critical stop

title: Screenless consent boundary
operation: Confirm device, action, recipient and consequence aloud for allowed classes
acceptance: High-risk action always requires appropriate separate gate

title: One-device absence drill
operation: Lose monitor/mouse while audio route remains authorized
acceptance: No task loss, user gets unambiguous status

title: Accessible pause/resume utterance
operation: Pause agent without losing consent or prior source; resume by authorized event
acceptance: No repeated user copy/paste required

title: Audio and haptic parity
operation: Deliver same semantic HOLD/ACK states via audio and optional haptics
acceptance: Equivalent content/error severity, not decorative patterns

title: R6 staged install decision
operation: Elect one reversible host replacement only when qualified
acceptance: One authoritative install receipt plus rollback/cold recovery

title: R6 acceptance decision
operation: Promote new bar version only after native quiet, cold restore and receiver proof
acceptance: Change log, rollback and human gate signed; not just version increment

title: Language/voice parity
operation: Compare typed and spoken command tasks with same WorkID source
acceptance: Accessibility quality and error rate, not just WER

title: No speaker echo loop
operation: TTS audio cannot become a new wake/command automatically
acceptance: Adversarial feedback test holds unwanted reentry

title: Two independent voice routes
operation: Use one phone and one separate home/PC route for the same task
acceptance: Voice WorkID survives first audio device disappearance

title: Voice false positive and echo
operation: Expose TV/feedback and ambiguous speech to wake parser
acceptance: No unwanted send/action; error category recorded

title: Screen-off voice acceptance
operation: Complete one useful task with display disabled and no mouse/keyboard
acceptance: User confirms completion, stop and replay controls through voice

title: Unattended screenless acceptance
operation: Complete 24-hour normal-life window with no mandatory typing/mouse/screen
acceptance: Real due tasks deliver, one human-safe exception interface remains
